invariants.text: Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Product.category_id must reference an existing Category.category_id
Category.category_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.order_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Order.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.customer_id
OrderItem.order_item_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
OrderItem.order_id must reference an existing Order.order_id
OrderItem.product_id must reference an existing Product.product_id
Invoice.invoice_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Invoice.order_id must reference an existing Order.order_id
When an order is confirmed, an invoice must be created with a total_amount equal to the sum of the product prices in the order items.
Confirming an order reserves the stock quantity of each product in the order by the quantity specified in the order item.
Cancelling a confirmed order releases the reserved stock for each product in the order by the quantity specified in the order item.
An order cannot be cancelled if it is not in the confirmed status.
An order cannot be confirmed if it already has a status of confirmed, shipped, or cancelled.
A product's stock_quantity cannot go below zero after any reservation or cancellation operation.
A customer can search their orders and invoices by customer_id or by order status.
An invoice must be linked to exactly one order via the order_id field.
A product must belong to a valid category identified by the category_id field.
The total_amount in an invoice must equal the sum of (product.price * order_item.quantity) for all items in the order.
